data.gender_notes: Eswari is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Eswari is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Eeshwara', which means 'Lord of the Universe'. This name is believed to be a form of the goddess Lakshmi, who is the deity of wealth and prosperity in Hindu mythology. Eswari is revered for her abundant blessings and is often invoked for financial success and material prosperity.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Eswari represents the divine power that bestows wealth, prosperity, and success upon Its devotees. It is a reminder of the universal abundance that is available to all, and a call to stay connected to the divine source of all blessings. Eswari is a powerful name that encourages material success while keeping the focus on the spiritual origin of all riches.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Eswari, meaning 'Goddess of Lord Shiva', embodies the divine feminine energy in Hinduism. She is a symbol of devotion, strength, and purity, representing the consort of Shiva and the power that sustains the universe.
